title: Design: Edit Customer shows Internal customer read-only while the setting is off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow0-12-06-edit-customer-setting-off.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The customer header shows no Internal badge.

Step 2:

  • The "Internal customer" checkbox is ticked and greyed out (cannot be changed), with the line "Turn on Internal Work Orders in Settings to change this." where "Settings" is a blue link.
  • No Default internal category select is shown.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-N4: “If the toggle is off, Edit Customer shows the checkbox only for a customer that already carries the flag, ticked and read-only, with the line "Turn on Internal Work Orders in Settings to change this." where Settings is a link; the Internal badge is hidden in the customer header, the customers list and the mobile card, so the read-only checkbox is the only trace of the flag. The flag has no effect on work orders until the toggle is on, and is removed by turning the setting on first.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
